shortBio.en: Tame Impala writer/producer; multi-tracked psych-pop recorded largely alone, then toured with a band.
shortBio.zh: Tame Impala 写歌/制作人；心理流行多轨大多独自录制，再以乐队编制巡演。

body.en: Born 1986, Perth. Writes, plays, and produces Tame Impala studio records largely as a solo multi-track process. Live shows use a full band around his parts.
body.zh: 1986 年生于珀斯。Tame Impala 录音室作品多为独自多轨写奏制。现场用完整乐队围绕其声部。
